column1: # walkthrough-map.tsv — the explicit correspondence between the numbered steps
# of docs/EAP/onboarding.md and the strings the acceptance specs assert.
# Three tab-separated fields: the heading text after "## ", the spec file, and a
# literal string that spec asserts. scripts/docs-tests-alignment.sh checks both
# sides: the heading must exist in the walkthrough, and the string must exist in
# the spec. A step no spec covers carries "-" in the spec field and a gap id in
# the third, and that id must be recorded in docs/signalloom/alignment-gaps.md.
# One heading may carry several rows. Every numbered step must carry at least one.
